integrity_notes: The all-parameter statement is supported by a symbolic support-bijection pebble strategy and path-forest reconstruction. Two finite-range checkers corroborate but do not prove the infinite theorem. Publication and independence are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Pure undirected simple adjacency and equality, finite triangular graphs only; no counting quantifiers.
Not an exact classification for arbitrary line graphs or richer signatures.
Historical priority is qualified by the possibility of an implicit stronger general result.
title: Exact width-depth coincidence for finite triangular graphs
